items.exampleEn: Living abroad for a year changed my outlook completely.
items.exampleZh: 在國外住了一年，徹底改變了我的觀點。

items.exampleEn: In this game, a red card signifies that you have lost a turn.
items.exampleZh: 在這個遊戲裡，紅卡表示你失去一次機會。

items.exampleEn: Heavy rain is probable this afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 今天下午很可能會下大雨。

items.exampleEn: The two reports contradict each other.
Please reconsider your decision before Friday.
items.exampleZh: 請在星期五前重新考慮你的決定。

items.exampleEn: Talking with my colleagues every day improved my listening comprehension.
items.exampleZh: 每天和同事聊天，提升了我的聽力理解能力。

items.exampleEn: I'm unsure whether the store is open today.
items.exampleZh: 我不確定那家店今天有沒有開。

items.exampleEn: Saving energy has become an imperative for every company.
items.exampleZh: 節約能源已成為每家公司必須做的事。

items.exampleEn: Scientists make generalizations from the results of many small studies.
items.exampleZh: 科學家從許多小型研究的結果中做出概括。

items.sentenceEn: The boss asked us to reconsider the plan because of the cost.
items.sentenceZh: 老闆因為成本問題，要我們重新考慮這個計畫。

items.audioEn: My sister is unsure about the date, so she will check her calendar first.
items.audioZh: 我妹妹不確定日期，所以她會先查行事曆。
items.questionZh: 說話者的妹妹接下來會做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The economic outlook for next year looks better.
items.sentenceZh: 明年的經濟前景看起來比較好。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't contradict me in front of the client.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要在客戶面前反駁我。

items.stemEn: The questions after the story test the students' ____ of what they read.
items.stemZh: 故事後面的問題測驗學生對讀過內容的理解。

items.stemEn: Dark clouds usually ____ that rain is coming.
items.stemZh: 烏雲通常表示快下雨了。

items.passageEn: Our team recently read a report about young workers. It said they have a positive outlook on work but are unsure about their long-term future. However, some of the findings seemed to contradict our own experience. For example, the report claimed that young people change jobs every year, which is a generalization; many of our young staff have stayed for five years or more. After a careful discussion, our comprehension of the problem improved. It is probable that the report studied only a few companies. Still, the fact that so many companies shared the report signifies something important: keeping good staff is an imperative. The manager now wants us to reconsider how we support new workers.
items.passageZh: 我們團隊最近讀了一份關於年輕員工的報告。報告說他們對工作抱持正面的看法，但對長期的未來不太確定。不過，有些發現似乎和我們自己的經驗互相矛盾。例如，報告說年輕人每年都換工作，這是以偏概全；我們公司很多年輕員工都待了五年以上。經過仔細討論，我們對這個問題的理解更深了。這份報告很可能只研究了少數幾家公司。儘管如此，這麼多公司轉傳這份報告，代表一件重要的事：留住好員工是必要的任務。經理現在要我們重新考慮該如何支持新進員工。

questions.questionZh: 報告說年輕員工對未來有什麼想法？
options: 對長期的未來不太確定
對長期的未來非常有把握
打算幾年內就出國去工作

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼認為「年輕人每年換工作」是以偏概全？
options: 公司裡的年輕員工人數其實很少
報告裡的日期和公司名稱都寫錯了
經理在會議上這樣告訴他們
很多年輕員工待超過五年

items.promptZh: 很多學生不確定畢業後要做什麼。
referenceEn: Many students are unsure what to do after graduation.
Many students are unsure about what to do after they graduate.
rubricZh: unsure 表示「不確定的」，後面可接 what、how、whether、about 等（例如 unsure what to do）
寫 not sure 意思也對

items.instructionZh: 用 probable 造一個句子，說說一件你認為很可能發生的事。
referenceEn: It is probable that I will change jobs next year.
I think a small rise in my rent is probable this year.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 probable，常用 It is probable that…，或放在 be 動詞後（例如 is probable）
句意要表示「很可能」，時態合理
